channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Javale McGee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Javale McGee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Javale McGee, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Jason Kidd shared, via ESPN.

“… [But] We believe we’re going to be a bigger team. Nothing against JB’s height. With Spencer (Dinwiddie) starting, our starting five is gonna be big with JaVale (McGee)at center. We believe that we’re going to be having a lot more offense coming off the bench.”

Jason Kidd on Javale McGee, Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 8, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Javale McGee
item.description:
Marc Berman:Popovich on picking C JaVale McGee:

“We decided that was the most logical and appropriate choice. Given the choices we had, he fit the best.”

Gregg Popovich on Javale McGee, Jul 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Michael Malone on Javale McGee
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on JaVale McGee:

“We're not just getting JaVale because he's a rim protector, he's a great pick-and-roller, lob threat. He's won three championship. He's been around winning. He's been around greatness.”

Michael Malone on Javale McGee, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Javale McGee
item.description:
Michael Singer:Connelly on JaVale McGee:

“I’ve always thought JaVale was a guy too harshly judged. ... He’s a complete pro.”

Tim Connelly on Javale McGee, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Javale McGee
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Vogel on Howard and McGee:

“Those guys have done a great job all season of partnering up to man the center position… this is a matchup where it favors us to flip flop the roles and (have Dwight start).”

Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Javale McGee, Sep 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Javale McGee
item.description:
Alex Caruso on headband:

“My new stylist JaVale McGee has been helping me out. We just decided yesterday at practice after goofing around & just stuck w it today. Played good w it tonight, so I guess we're going to stay w it for now. Not a 1-time thing. We're going to stay w it.”

Alex Caruso on Javale McGee, Jan 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Javale McGee
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Luke Walton on JaVale McGee's 7 blks:

“He covered up some of our mistakes. He has done that all season. JaVale had a good game but as a whole we didn't do a good job.”

Luke Walton on Javale McGee, Nov 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee
item.description:
Tyson Chandler on JaVale McGee:

“Before I got here, I was saying how amazing he was playing & now that I'm getting a chance to watch him & be a part of this team with him, I think he's playing incredible basketball. Probably the best basketball of his career right now.”

Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee
item.description:
Tyson Chandler on JaVale McGee:

“It's not about me & him. I not here to take anybody's job. I'm here to help make the team better. My hope is to make his job easier, so he stays fresh & so he can play throughout the year & gives us the type of mins that he's given as well as me.”

Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Tyson Chandler on JaVale McGee:

“The goal is for us to help each other. Not go against each other.”

Tyson Chandler on Javale McGee, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Javale McGee
item.description:
#Lakers GM Rob Pelinka on JaVale McGee:

“JaVale changes the geometry of the game. His unique combination of incredible length and foot nimbleness will allow us to play fast at both ends.”

Rob Pelinka on Javale McGee, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Javale McGee
item.description:
Madelyn Burke:Shaq on Javale McGee feud:

“If I was a player and was so worried about being on Shaqtin a Fool, I wouldn't mess up”

Shaquille O'Neal on Javale McGee, Mar 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @MadelynBurke.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Javale McGee, Kenneth Faried
item.description:
Bogut told reporters Saturday.

“I'm just playing physical like they are. If someone steps up and wants to get into it, I've got no problem with that. It’s nothing personal. They’re physical. Kenneth Faried runs around and hits people. We just have to match their intensity. If it gets personal during games and guys want to have a crack at you, that’s playoff basketball. I’m not sitting here saying I hate McGee or I hate Faried. But if they want to be physical, we’re going to be physical back. We’re not going to take a step backward.”

Andrew Bogut on Javale McGee, Kenneth Faried, Apr 27, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: George Karl on Javale McGee, Evan Fournier
item.description:
George Karl:

“I’m sure that McGee will sign. That’s what our management is working on daily basis and I trust them. We don’t want to do a mistake about the free agents and try to do the best. The evidence is Fournier can be a NBA player. I think he played pretty good here, in Vegas. He showed us his style, his excitement to play here and hopefully he can follow our program”

George Karl on Javale McGee, Evan Fournier, Jul 18, 2012. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Nick Young on Javale McGee
item.description:
Nick Young is one of McGee’s best friends on the team, having been with him the past three seasons, and tried to defend him.

“Good for him, being that brave to even think of doing that. That’s JaVale McGee. He can jump out the gym. That’s a good way to get him going by dunking. That gets his offense going, makes him start blocking shots,”

Nick Young on Javale McGee, Jan 17, 2012. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Javale McGee
item.description:
Lisa Dillman:Eric Gordon on JaVale McGee:

“You don’t see too many athletes like him out there. Just none. Him and DeAndre.”

Eric Gordon on Javale McGee, Mar 26, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Javale McGee
item.description:
Ron Artest on JaVale McGee:

“I don't think he watches tape. I think he plays video games& I think he could possibly have an Atari.”

Metta World Peace on Javale McGee, Dec 15, 2010. Source: Twitter.
